title: Legend
author: Marie Lu
summary: In a divided future Los Angeles, June is a prodigy soldier from a wealthy family, and Day is the country's most wanted criminal. When her brother is killed, she is sent to hunt him, though neither is quite what they seem.
readIf: you want a fast, easy-to-read dystopian adventure with two alternating narrators.
skipIf: you want original world-building or a quiet, thoughtful read.

pairings.reason: The best-known young adult dystopia, with a more intense and emotional edge.
Another fast YA dystopia about a young woman who does not fit the system.
An adult dystopian story about class, rebellion and a hero who infiltrates the elite.
